local_patch_scope: Terminal JSON-RPC response delivery only: retain upstream notification anti-replay behavior and 3-attempt notification budget; give terminal responses a 15-minute bounded retry window with a 256-attempt hard cap while preserving parent-context cancellation. The retry loop only resends the already-built terminal TunnelResponse and never re-enters MCP dispatch or tool execution.
verification: Targeted Go unit tests passed for terminal retry budget, same-request transport retry, notification anti-replay, pre-write notification retry, parent-context cancellation, non-retryable 4xx, and idempotent terminal 404 handling. The derived Windows executable was statically inspected as a PE built with Go 1.27.0, windows/amd64, CGO disabled and trimpath enabled. No production MCP, Tunnel, or Electron process was started, stopped, restarted, killed, or crash-injected during this acceptance.
